executionOrder: Create a Squads v4 multisig with three independent signer wallets and a 2-of-3 threshold; do not use a unilateral config authority.
Enable a 24-hour global timelock and do not configure spending limits during the foundation phase.
Create or identify separate Strategic Reserve and Ecosystem Reserve vault owner addresses.
Perform a small test transfer to each vault and verify recovery/approval workflow before moving reserve-scale balances.
Transfer exactly 200000000 sKAM to the Strategic Reserve vault and exactly 100000000 sKAM to the Ecosystem Reserve vault.
Run the read-only reserve verifier and require exact reserve balances before any authority revocation.
Revoke sKAM Mint Authority in a dedicated Phantom-approved transaction and verify on-chain that it is null.
Revoke sKAM Freeze Authority in a separate Phantom-approved transaction and verify on-chain that it is null.
Run the final live audit again and publish the reserve addresses and governance policy as transparency evidence.

publicDisclosure.reserveDescription: 300M sKAM is treasury-governed reserve allocation; 700M is the maximum available ecosystem allocation, not an externally verified circulating-supply figure.

futureHardening.note: A governance multisig with a transaction timelock is not the same as an immutable fixed-date token lock. Do not market it as one.
